game.title: Lightkeeper
upg.net.name: Net
upg.net.desc: Catches what drifts by and drops it in the chest. Mend it to catch faster.
upg.storage.name: Storage chest
upg.storage.desc: The net fills this up; tap the chest to take it all. Mend it to hold more.
offline.title: When the tide went out
save.corrupt: The old save couldn't be read, so the lighthouse starts anew. The old save was kept aside.
chest.label: Storage chest, tap to collect
offline.chestFull: The chest filled up, and there was no room for the rest.
debug.resetConfirm: Wipe the test save and start over? (Your real save is untouched.)
upg.light.name: Lighthouse
upg.light.desc: Mend the lighthouse so its light reaches farther.
upg.light.next.dock: Next: repair the dock and build a boat.
upg.light.next.reach: Next: the light reaches farther out to sea.
upg.light.next.glow: Needs glowshards, found only on Firefly Isle.
upg.speed.name: Speed
upg.cargo.name: Cargo hold
upg.cargo.desc: Bring back more from every trip.
map.title: Sea chart
map.locked: Mend the lighthouse to level 3 to repair the dock and build a boat.
map.buildDesc: The dock is ready. Build a small boat and see what the light can reach.
map.unknownDesc: The light has only just reached it. Go and see.
map.dark: The light doesn't reach here yet.
map.away: The boat is on its way to {name}, {time} to go.
map.waiting: The boat is back. Tap it at the dock to unload.
map.pick: Tap a lit spot on the chart to choose where to go.
dest.wreck.name: Wreck Reef
dest.wreck.desc: An old ship ran aground here. Its hold is still full of scrap metal.
dest.gullrock.name: Gull Rock
dest.gullrock.desc: Seabirds nest here. One followed you home and now keeps an eye on the net.
dest.oldlight.name: The Old Lighthouse
dest.oldlight.desc: Another keeper's lighthouse. Inside, you found their old plans.
dest.firefly.name: Firefly Isle
dest.firefly.desc: At night the whole island glows. Its glowshards make the lighthouse brighter.
dest.firefly.perk: The only place to find glowshards
discover.title: A new island
boat.label: Boat
offline.boat: The boat is back and waiting at the dock to be unloaded.
island.store: Waiting on the island (the boat brings it home next visit):
island.storeEmpty: Nothing waiting on the island yet.
island.pick: Tap a plot or a building.
bld.dismantler.name: Breaking bench
bld.dismantler.desc: Strips the wreck bit by bit, saving up scrap metal.
bld.rack.name: Net rack
bld.rack.desc: Dries old nets from the wreck and twists them into rope.
bld.boatshed.name: Boat shed
bld.boatshed.desc: A place to mend the boat. A well-kept boat sails faster.
bld.nest.name: Gull house
bld.nest.desc: A home for the gulls. They bring back bottles from the sea.
bld.kelp.name: Kelp frame
bld.kelp.desc: Dries kelp to twist into strong rope.
bld.lookout.name: Lookout
bld.lookout.desc: From up high the gulls spot drift early and steer it toward your net.
bld.depot.name: Old depot
bld.depot.desc: The other keeper's store. There is still timber inside.
bld.workshop.name: Workshop
bld.workshop.desc: A mended forge turns scrap into useful parts.
bld.desk.name: Keeper's desk
bld.desk.desc: Their notes teach you thriftier ways to mend the lighthouse.
bld.jars.name: Firefly jars
bld.jars.desc: The fireflies leave a little light in each jar, slowly gathering into glowshards.
bld.orchard.name: Orchard
bld.orchard.desc: The island's trees grow well; prunings make good timber.
bld.path.name: Glowing path
bld.path.desc: A path of light to find your way home at night. The chest holds more.
pass.title: Pass the light on
pass.text: The lighthouse is mended and {from} is lit. You can leave it to the wind and the gulls, and go light another lighthouse on {to}.
pass.keep: This sea will stay lit: the net and the island buildings keep working, and you can come back any time.
pass.gain: You will gain {n} starlight ✦. Each one adds {p}% to everything you produce, for good.
toast.allLit: Every sea is lit. Thank you, lightkeeper.
dest.fog.wreck.name: Fogbound Wreck
dest.fog.wreck.desc: A great ship looms in and out of the fog. The iron in its hold hasn't rusted yet.
dest.fog.gullrock.name: Mistgull Rock
dest.fog.gullrock.desc: Gull cries sound close in the fog. One knows the lighthouse and followed you home.
dest.fog.oldlight.name: The Silent Lighthouse
dest.fog.oldlight.desc: This lighthouse has been dark a long time. A keeper's log lies open on the desk.
dest.fog.firefly.name: Phosphor Isle
dest.fog.firefly.desc: Waves break in faint blue light. Here, that light gathers into glowshards.
dest.aurora.wreck.name: Icebound Hulk
dest.aurora.wreck.desc: A whole ship frozen into the ice. Break it open and there's metal to salvage.
dest.aurora.gullrock.name: Snowgull Cliff
dest.aurora.gullrock.desc: White gulls crowd the snowy cliff. They're happy to watch your net.
dest.aurora.oldlight.name: The Aurora Light
dest.aurora.oldlight.desc: The northernmost lighthouse of the old stories. Its light is the colour of the aurora.
dest.aurora.firefly.name: Icefly Grotto
dest.aurora.firefly.desc: Deep in the ice cave, small glowing creatures stay awake all winter.

goal.collectChest: Tap the chest to take what the net caught
goal.mendNet: Mend the net so it catches faster
goal.unload: The boat is back: tap it to unload
goal.dock: Mend the lighthouse to level 3 to repair the dock
goal.buildBoat: Open the sea chart and build a boat
goal.sail: The boat is idle: send it out from the sea chart
goal.rest: The sea is quiet. Things will drift in.
goal.label: Next
arrival.title: While you were away
arrival.cap: The chest filled up and the rest drifted off. It holds {h} hours; mend it to hold more.
arrival.boat: The boat came back from {name} with:
arrival.island: Waiting on the islands for the boat to fetch:
ms.island1: Island milestone: all three buildings at level 3, +25% output ({done}/3)
ms.island2: Island milestone: all three at level 5, +50% more ({done}/3)
book.title: Book of driftwood finds
book.bonus: Each find adds 1% to everything you produce: +{n}% so far.
book.pageDone: This sea's page is complete: +10% more here.
book.pageGoal: Complete this page: +10% more at this sea.
hint.common: Drifts in from the sea; the boat or the chest may bring one too.
hint.light: Drifts in once the lighthouse reaches level {n}.
hint.boat: Send the boat to {name} to look for it.
hint.legend: Once the lighthouse reaches level {n}, send the boat to {name}.
curio.dusk:0.name: Scallop shell
curio.dusk:0.line: Rings on the shell, like tide after tide, year after year.
curio.dusk:1.name: Glass float
curio.dusk:1.line: Fell off someone's net. A little sunset is trapped inside.
curio.dusk:2.name: Old compass
curio.dusk:2.line: It no longer points north. It seems to point at the lighthouse.
curio.dusk:3.name: Wooden toy boat
curio.dusk:3.line: A name is carved on the hull, worn too smooth to read.
curio.dusk:4.name: Starfish
curio.dusk:4.line: It crawled slowly across your palm, then back into the sea.
curio.dusk:5.name: Rusty key
curio.dusk:5.line: Who knows what door it opens. Somewhere far away, maybe.
curio.dusk:6.name: Ship's lamp
curio.dusk:6.line: A little oil left. Light it, and something seems to answer.
curio.dusk:7.name: Coral branch
curio.dusk:7.line: It grew in warmer water. Somehow it drifted all the way here.
curio.dusk:8.name: Message in a bottle
curio.dusk:8.line: "If you find this, look at tonight's sea for me."
curio.dusk:9.name: The keeper's pocket watch
curio.dusk:9.line: Stopped at a quarter past six, one evening long ago.
curio.dusk:10.name: Glowing conch
curio.dusk:10.line: Hold it to your ear: a faraway lighthouse is talking.
curio.dusk:11.name: Heart of the fireflies
curio.dusk:11.line: All the light on Firefly Isle began here.
curio.fog:0.name: Fog bell
curio.fog:0.line: When the fog is thickest, it rings softly by itself.
curio.fog:1.name: Faded pennant
curio.fog:1.line: Only the fog remembers what colour it was.
curio.fog:2.name: Broken spyglass
curio.fog:2.line: Through the crack, the sea becomes two seas.
curio.fog:3.name: Fisherman's cap
curio.fog:3.line: Tucked in the brim: a paper full of tide times.
curio.fog:4.name: Gull feather
curio.fog:4.line: Gulls in the fog know the way better than you'd think.
curio.fog:5.name: Tin whistle
curio.fog:5.line: Blow it once, and something far off answers.
curio.fog:6.name: Old ferry ticket
curio.fog:6.line: One way, to a port that isn't on any map.
curio.fog:7.name: Salt-crusted knot
curio.fog:7.line: Whoever tied this was very afraid it would come undone.
curio.fog:8.name: An unsent letter
curio.fog:8.line: The envelope says only: "To whoever keeps the light."
curio.fog:9.name: The Silent Lighthouse's log
curio.fog:9.line: The last page reads: "Tonight I saw the light again."
curio.fog:10.name: Phosphor jellyfish
curio.fog:10.line: It glows slowly in the jar, as if breathing.
curio.fog:11.name: Wick of the fog
curio.fog:11.line: When this wick burns, the fog opens a path on its own.
curio.aurora:0.name: Ice crystal
curio.aurora:0.line: No two arms alike, like no two winters.
curio.aurora:1.name: Reindeer bell
curio.aurora:1.line: Fell from which herd, nobody knows.
curio.aurora:2.name: Knitted mitten
curio.aurora:2.line: Just the one. The other is probably still waiting.
curio.aurora:3.name: Frozen fish
curio.aurora:3.line: It still seems to be swimming, only very, very slowly.
curio.aurora:4.name: Sled runner
curio.aurora:4.line: The snow it crossed reached farther than this sea.
curio.aurora:5.name: Arctic fox tooth
curio.aurora:5.line: Small and sharp. The fox has a new one by now.
curio.aurora:6.name: Aurora photograph
curio.aurora:6.line: Someone smiling in the photo, the sky behind them green.
curio.aurora:7.name: Coin in ice
curio.aurora:7.line: Until the ice melts, it isn't going anywhere.
curio.aurora:8.name: Polar chart
curio.aurora:8.line: At the very top, someone drew a tiny lighthouse.
curio.aurora:9.name: Key to the Aurora Light
curio.aurora:9.line: Hold it and your palm glows faintly green.
curio.aurora:10.name: Icefly amber
curio.aurora:10.line: A firefly sleeps inside, waiting for summer.
curio.aurora:11.name: Shard of the aurora
curio.aurora:11.line: A piece of the sky's light fell into your sea.
tree.title: Starlight tree
tree.passive: Each star still adds {p}% to everything you produce, for good.
tree.resetConfirm: Take back all your starlight and spend it again? It costs {n} starlight.
tree.lock.fog: Opens once you reach the Foggy Night Sea
tree.lock.aurora: Opens once you reach the Aurora Ice Sea
talent.net1.name: Finer mesh
talent.chest2.name: Deeper chest
talent.prod3.name: Warm lamp
talent.autoChest.name: No need to worry
talent.autoChest.desc: While the game is open, a full chest empties itself.
talent.voy1.name: Fair wind
talent.haul2.name: Full hold
talent.haul2.desc: Bring back 30% more from every trip.
talent.isl3.name: Busy islands
talent.autoBoat.name: Old sailor
talent.autoBoat.desc: The boat unloads itself and sails back to the same place, even while you're away.
talent.cur1.name: Keen eye
talent.rare2.name: Old charts
talent.rare2.desc: Rare curios need 2 fewer lighthouse levels, and turn up 1.5× as often again.
talent.drift3.name: Generous tide
talent.drift3.desc: Tapping drift gives twice as much.
talent.start3.name: Light passed on
talent.start3.desc: Each new sea starts with its lighthouse at level 3.
world.noWebgl: This browser can't draw the 3D scene — try another browser?
credits.title: Credits
credits.intro: The models in this game are free assets by these makers. Thank you!
polish.do: Polish the lamp ({n} glow) · more finds for half an hour
upg.recycle.name: Recycler
upg.recycle.desc: Turns spare bottles into rope and spare wood into parts.
upg.recycle.next.build: Once built: spare bottles become rope, spare wood becomes parts.
pass.mats: Your materials stay behind; they become {m} of those stars.
decor.title: Island decorations
decor.desc: Only makes the island prettier; it changes no numbers.
land.title: Grow the island
land.desc: Fill in new ground with wood and plastic; the island grows ring by ring. Only gives room; changes no numbers.
land.full: The island is as big as it gets
story.wreck.1: The boat circled {name} and hauled a few coils of rope out of the upturned hold.
story.wreck.2: At low tide the deck of {name} showed above water; the crew pried off some iron plates.
story.wreck.3: A hermit crab guarding the rusty anchor would not budge, so the boat went round the other side.
story.wreck.4: By the wheel of {name}: a soaked logbook whose last page is a drawing of this lighthouse.
story.wreck.5: The waves nudged a bottle to the boat. The note inside just says: "Thank you for the light."
story.gullrock.1: The gulls of {name} circled the boat, calling as if counting the day's fish.
story.gullrock.2: The rock cracks were thick with kelp; the crew cut a full hold.
story.gullrock.3: A young gull followed the boat half the way and rested on the mast.
story.gullrock.4: When the fog came in, the birds of {name} called the boat back on course.
story.gullrock.5: The nests on top were stuffed with lost bottles; the gulls kindly shared some.
story.oldlight.1: The old keeper on {name} left a pot of hot tea and a note: "Help yourself."
story.oldlight.2: Sacks of timber from the store on {name}; a tide table decades old still hangs on the wall.
story.oldlight.3: The old stairs creaked; at the top the old lens flashed once in the sunset.
story.oldlight.4: Behind the store, a little workshop with every tool in its place, as if its owner just stepped out.
story.oldlight.5: On the way home, the two lighthouses flashed to each other across the sea.
story.firefly.1: At dusk the woods of {name} lit up with fireflies; the crew just stared.
story.firefly.2: A boatload of fruit from the orchard on {name}; fireflies followed us to the shore.
story.firefly.3: Glass jars left by someone on the forest path, just right for glowshards.
story.firefly.4: Landing, the boat startled a cloud of fireflies, like warm rain over the sea.
story.firefly.5: Deep in the woods, a hollow old tree with a small light that never goes out.
story.bonus.haul: A lucky trip: a bigger haul.
story.bonus.early: A fair wind brought it home early.
ask.wreck: The old beachcomber needs {n} {mat} to patch his little boat.
ask.gullrock: The bird-watching kid needs {n} {mat} for a sheltered gull nest.
ask.oldlight: The old keeper needs {n} {mat} to rebind the stair rail.
ask.firefly: The fruit picker in the woods needs {n} {mat} to fix the orchard waterwheel.
ask.done: The people here are old friends now and load a little more onto your boat.
ask.thanks: The people of {name} are delighted (friendship {n}/{max}) and gave you a little glow.
story.ice: The boat spent the whole trip breaking ice around {name} and opened a channel. Nothing came home this time; next time it can land.
map.fogged: The fog is too thick for the boat to find the way. Mend the lighthouse to level {n} to see through.
